data.long_meaning: Nathu means 'Lord' and Ram means 'Earth'. The name Nathuram signifies the one who is the Lord of the Earth and is full of courage and strength. The name Nathuram carries the meaning “Lord of the Earth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Nathuram usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nathuram is a name that signifies devotion to Lord Shiva, the God of the Universe and the source of all creation.
data.etymology: Nathuram belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Earth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nathuram total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

The name carries a sense of respect and authority, reflecting the deep reverence for the divine and the natural world in Hinduism.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nathuram represents the spiritual belief that the divine is present in all forms of nature and that the individual is a manifestation of the divine. It also signifies the idea of surrendering oneself to the divine, seeking its guidance and protection. historical_references.reference: Nathuram Godse was an Indian nationalist and the assassin of Mahatma Gandhi in 1948. He believed Gandhi's policies were detrimental to Hindus and India as a whole. His actions were seen as a radical response to Gandhi's nonviolent resistance movement.

Nathuram Rashtriya was a Maratha warrior king who ruled the region around present-day Maharashtra in the late 17th century. He is remembered for his military victories against the Mughals and his efforts to establish a strong Maratha Empire.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Nathuram' is rooted in Hinduism and is derived from 'Nath', a title given to revered saints and 'Ram', the name of the revered Hindu deity Lord Rama. In modern context, this name is often associated with devotionalism, nationalism, and heroism. In Indian movies and TV shows, characters with this name are portrayed as pious and self-sacrificing, often embodying the ideals of devotion and duty. In religious pilgrimages, Nathuram is a common name among Hindu devotees. In literature and folklore, stories of Nathuram are passed down through generations, reflecting values of devotion, duty, and heroism.

name_in_real_life.story: Devi Nathuram from Bali, Indonesia embodies the meaning of Nathuram - "Lord of the Earth". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
